summary: Iter-12: Validated Şampiyon chat history persistence (per-user, server-side) and hands-free (VAD) UI toggle. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_history.py — 7/7 PASS covering GET /api/sampiyon/history empty state + schema (role/content/created_at/tool_names, oldest→newest), POST /api/sampiyon/chat persistence of both user & assistant messages, DB-backed context autoload when body history is empty (nonce recall works), explicit body.history override of DB context (name='FARUK' recalled, not 'MURAT_DB'), user isolation (Murat marker not leaked to Özkan), and DELETE /api/sampiyon/history. Existing regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_regression.py: 14/15 PASS (1 flaky model non-determinism on 'ödeme' tool_call — same test flaked historically). Frontend (Playwright headless, murat@karivo.local, --use-fake-ui/-device-for-media-stream + context.grant_permissions(['microphone'])): (a) login → fab open → send 'Selam, bu test mesaji A1B2.' → assistant reply rendered as sampiyon-msg-2. (b) Reload (networkidle) → still logged in (ks_token in localStorage) → open panel → previous user+assistant messages restored (GET /api/sampiyon/history fired, 200, 2 msgs). (c) sampiyon-new-chat click → messages reset to 1 (only welcome) + backend history len=0. Reload after new-chat → still only welcome shown. (d) sampiyon-handsfree-toggle: initial text='Eller Serbest Modu Aç', after click text='Eller serbest açık — konuş, susunca gönderirim', emerald class applied, sampiyon-handsfree-level indicator visible, sampiyon-mic disabled while handsfree ON. Second click → OFF state restored. (e) While handsfree ON, outside-click closes panel; reopening panel resets handsfree to OFF ('Eller Serbest Modu Aç'). All assertions passed. Cleaned up Murat+Özkan history via DELETE at end.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still grows (now covers history endpoints too) — strongly recommend extracting Şampiyon routes/tools/handlers into backend/routers/sampiyon.py and backend/services/sampiyon.py.
_load_sampiyon_history limit is hard-coded (12 for context, 60 for GET). Consider exposing as env var or query param (?limit=) for debuggability and to tune LLM token cost without redeploy.

GET /api/sampiyon/history returns the raw stored shape including internal 'id' and 'user_id'. 'user_id' is leaked back to the client — not sensitive here (self), but tightening the projection to {role, content, tool_names, created_at} would be cleaner and remove the id/user_id noise.

_sampiyon_events writes the user message to Mongo BEFORE calling the model. If the model subsequently 500s, the user turn is persisted but no assistant turn — on next load the history will have a trailing unanswered user message, which could confuse the model. Consider either (a) writing both in a single document atomically after the model finishes, or (b) deleting the orphan user doc on failure.
No pagination/cap on sampiyon_messages growth per user. Over months this collection will grow unbounded. Add a TTL index or a background trim job (keep last N or last 90 days).

SampiyonWidget history useEffect runs with empty deps and ignores errors silently (`.catch(() => {})`). If the backend ever starts returning 500, the user sees empty welcome state with no indication the history fetch failed. Add a toast on error or at least a console.warn.

setMessages(data.map(...)) replaces the WELCOME when history has >=1 message. That is intentional, but the welcome message is lost even after new-chat if you then send 1 msg and reload (user sees only [user, assistant], no welcome anymore). Minor UX nit; could prepend welcome locally without persisting it.
useHandsFree hook uses MediaRecorder + VAD timings (120ms onset, 1200ms silence) hard-coded in the hook; expose as options so this can be tuned without touching the hook.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new history suite (7/7). Regression: 14/15 (one flaky model tool-call — pre-existing).
success_rate.frontend: 100% on new flows (persistence, new-chat, reload-after-new-chat, handsfree toggle text/color/level, mic-disabled-while-handsfree, outside-click close, reopen reset).

seed_data_creation: During tests, Murat chat history was seeded via POST /api/sampiyon/chat with nonces/markers (TEST_MARKER_*, TEST_ISOLATION_*). All messages cleaned via DELETE /api/sampiyon/history for both users at suite end and after Playwright run. No persistent side effects.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new suite with: `pytest -o addopts= /app/backend/tests/test_sampiyon_history.py -v` (no -n xdist). It depends on BOTH Murat and Özkan credentials. Each test clears history for its user to isolate. For UI, use context.grant_permissions(['microphone'], origin=BASE) + Playwright launch args --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream --use-fake-device-for-media-stream to make handsfree enablement succeed in headless. Panel is auto-closed by outside-click (document-level pointerdown listener), so when driving the panel programmatically, click only inside sampiyon-panel. Reload persistence check: wait for `networkidle` (not just domcontentloaded) OR wait 2+ seconds after reload — mounting of SampiyonWidget inside Layout fires GET /api/sampiyon/history async. Hands-free toggle emerald class = ON state detector. The regression suite's flaky test is `test_add_cari_and_transaction` (model occasionally claims to have called add_cari_transaction without actually calling the tool); already noted in iter-11.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs. All requested features (chat history persistence per user, context autoload from DB, user isolation, new-chat reset, handsfree VAD toggle with level indicator, mic auto-disable while handsfree, outside-click panel close + handsfree reset on reopen) are implemented correctly and verified.
